node.title: Re^3: scp file from windows10 to unix server
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Mine is ActiveState perl very old version 5.8.8, So I do not have IPC::System::Simple and Win32::ShellQuote modules availble.

As always, [id://693828].

But even in the worst case, [mod://Win32::ShellQuote] is a small, pure-Perl module, that you can even manually copy over, or use something like [mod://App::FatPacker] on (the same goes for [mod://IPC::System::Simple]).
